name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest open PR with a known issue first. This gives immediate feedback on active work where fixes matter most. Trade-off: we delay testing the oldest merged PR, but fresh issues have higher urgency.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on the newest open PR tests only the latest routing and prompt—it ignores the oldest merged PRs where persistent bugs hide. Test the oldest merged PR first; if it fails, we know the fix is urgent and the routing is broken. If it passes, then shadow mode on the newest PR is safe.
